hook.text: Companies used to manage financial, safety, and legal risk in separate silos. Nobody saw the full picture.

buildup.text: Enterprise Risk Management connects all risk types into one framework overseen by leadership.

discovery.text: The COSO ERM framework, published in 2004, became the global standard for integrated risk.

twist.text: ERM looks great on paper. Many companies treat it as a checkbox, not a living process.

climax.text: Integrated risk management only works when leaders take it seriously, not just when auditors visit.

punchline.text: See all risks together or miss the fatal one.

quiz.question: What is Enterprise Risk Management?
options: A framework integrating all risk types into one view
A government regulation for big firms
